name: Purple Harness (DSH fork)
summary: Wes's fork of DeepSeek Harness (DSH), being built into Purple Harness: a model-independent operating environment where models are workers and the harness owns permissions, memory, history, verification and orchestration. Runs in a hardened Docker container on creature (no capabilities, 4 GB, writes only docker/workspace). Build plan: the purple-setup skill, 8 phases each with a proof.
goal: A harness that enforces its own rules and proves work is done, so cheap models can run long jobs safely.
